errors.unauthorized: web_search: Ollama API key rejected: check OLLAMA_API_KEY.
errors.rateLimit: web_search: Ollama web search is rate-limited or quota-limited.
errors.serverError: web_search: Ollama web search returned HTTP {status}.
errors.fetchMissingKey: web_fetch: Ollama web fetch requires an API key: set OLLAMA_API_KEY or `ollamaApiKey` in ~/.reasonix/config.json.
errors.fetchUnauthorized: web_fetch: Ollama API key rejected: check OLLAMA_API_KEY.
errors.fetchRateLimit: web_fetch: Ollama web fetch is rate-limited or quota-limited.
errors.fetchServerError: web_fetch: Ollama web fetch returned HTTP {status} for {url}.
